title: 第23章 栽赃陷害第24章 三日之后风雨欲来
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
额？
随着楚风话音响起，所有人的目光齐刷刷地汇聚到了他的身上。
而楚风直接端起侍女刚倒的那杯酒，施施然地走向了三皇子陆丰。
唰！
陆丰看着楚风径直朝自己走来，眼皮莫名一跳，心中陡然生出一股不祥的预感。
这家伙想干什么？
“三殿下，昨日你我之间有些小恩怨，是我楚风不懂事，在这里给你赔个不是。”
楚风脸上挂着和煦的笑容，将自己手中的酒杯轻轻放在陆丰面前的玉石桌上，然后顺手就端起了陆丰原来那杯，仰头一饮而尽，动作行云流水。
“这杯酒，你我干了，从此一酒化干戈！”
当即，陆丰整个人都懵了。
现场众人也是看得一头雾水，这镇北世子刚才还剑拔弩张，怎么突然就转性了？
楚风放下空酒杯，看着呆若木鸡的陆丰，故作不解地问道：“三皇子，怎么不喝？莫非还记恨着我，不想与我和解？”
陆丰嘴角狠狠抽搐了几下，面前这杯酒，他哪里敢喝！
可楚风的话已经把他架在了火上，他脸上挤出一抹比哭还难看的笑容：“楚世子言重了，你我之间，哪有什么恩怨。”
“既然没有恩怨，那更应该喝了这杯酒！”
楚风笑容不减，话锋却陡然一转，带上了一丝压迫感，“也当是庆祝太子妃生辰大吉！
还是说，三殿下瞧不起我楚风，不屑于喝我敬的这杯酒？”
唰！
陆丰的脸色瞬间僵硬，额角渗出细密的冷汗，眸光急速闪烁，最终只能硬着头皮说道：“当然不是，只是……只是本殿下今日身体不适，不宜饮酒！”
“哦？”

楚风眉毛一扬，脸上的笑容瞬间消失，取而代之的是一片冰冷，“是不宜饮酒，还是三殿下心里清楚，我这酒里……有毒？”
什么？酒里有毒？！
此话一出，宛如平地惊雷！
满座宾客全都骇然失色，下意识地看向自己面前的酒杯，不少人更是吓得直接将酒杯打翻在地。
太子陆元更是“噌”
地一下站了起来，面色大变：“楚世子，你说什么？”
“大家不必紧张，有毒的，只是我这一杯而已！”
楚风说着，拿起陆丰面前那杯毒酒，手腕一抖，将酒水倾倒在地。
滋啦——
酒水接触到光洁如镜的玉石地面，竟冒起一阵黑烟，发出一阵刺耳的腐蚀声，地面上赫然出现了一个触目惊心的小坑！
嘶！
大殿内响起一片倒吸凉气的声音，所有人看着那个小坑，后背都窜起一股寒意。
陆元的脸色瞬间沉到了谷底，而那位给楚风倒酒的侍女更是双腿一软，直接瘫倒在地，面无血色。
“是你下的毒？”
萧霓凰凤眸一寒，锐利的目光如刀子般射向那侍女。
“不……不是我……”
content_en:
Forehead?
As Chu Feng's words sounded, everyone's eyes focused on him.
Chu Feng directly picked up the glass of wine that the maid had just poured and walked towards the third prince Lu Feng calmly.
Uh-huh!
Lu Feng saw Chu Feng walking straight towards him, his eyelids twitched inexplicably, and an ominous premonition suddenly arose in his heart.
What does this guy want to do?
"Your Highness, there was a little grudge between you and me yesterday. I, Chu Feng, was not sensible, so I am here to make amends to you."
With a warm smile on his face, Chu Feng gently placed the wine glass in his hand on the jade table in front of Lu Feng, then picked up Lu Feng's original glass, raised his head and drank it all in one gulp, with smooth movements.
"You and I drank this glass of wine, and from now on we will fight over it!"
Immediately, Lu Feng was stunned.
Everyone at the scene was also confused. The Prince of Zhenbei was so tense just now, why did he suddenly change his gender?
Chu Feng put down the empty wine glass, looked at the dumbfounded Lu Feng, and asked pretending to be puzzled: "Third Prince, why don't you drink? Could it be that you still hate me and don't want to reconcile with me?"
The corners of Lu Feng's mouth twitched fiercely. How dare he drink the glass of wine in front of him!
But Chu Feng's words had already put him on fire, and he squeezed out a smile that was uglier than crying: "Chu Shizi said seriously, there is no grudge between you and me."
"Since there is no grudge, it is even more important to drink this glass of wine!"
Chu Feng's smile did not diminish, but the conversation suddenly changed, bringing with it a sense of oppression, "This should be a celebration of the Crown Princess's birthday!
Or is it that the Third Highness looks down on me, Chu Feng, and disdains to drink the glass of wine I propose? "
Uh-huh!
Lu Feng's face instantly stiffened, a thin layer of cold sweat broke out on his forehead, his eyes flashed rapidly, and finally he could only bite the bullet and said: "Of course not, it's just... His Highness is not feeling well today and should not drink alcohol!"
"Oh?"
Chu Feng raised his eyebrows, and the smile on his face disappeared instantly, replaced by a cold look, "Is it not suitable to drink alcohol, or does the Third Highness know in your heart that my wine is...poisonous?"
What? Is there poison in the wine? !
As soon as these words came out, it was like thunder on the ground!
All the guests turned pale with shock and subconsciously looked at the wine glasses in front of them. Many people were so frightened that they knocked their wine glasses to the ground.
Prince Lu Yuan is even more "miserable"
He stood up immediately, his face changed drastically: "Chu Shizi, what did you say?"
"Don't be nervous, everyone, it's just my cup that's poisonous!"
Chu Feng said, picked up the glass of poisonous wine in front of Lu Feng, flicked his wrist, and poured the wine to the ground.
Zila——
When the wine came into contact with the smooth, mirror-like jade floor, a burst of black smoke appeared, a harsh corrosive sound was emitted, and a shocking small pit suddenly appeared on the ground!
hiss!
There was a gasp of cold air in the hall, and everyone looked at the small pit, and a chill ran down their backs.
Lu Yuan's face suddenly sank to the bottom of his face, and the maid who poured wine for Chu Feng even weakened her legs and collapsed directly to the ground, her face bloodless.
"Did you poison me?"
Xiao Nihuang's phoenix eyes turned cold, and her sharp gaze shot towards the maid like a knife.
"No...it's not me..."
